title: Binance Options RFQ Will Launch XRPUSDT Options
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Options RFQ and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance will launch XRPUSDT Options on  Binance Options RFQ   on  2024-03-11  at  08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   XRPUSDT Options are European-style options contracts. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. Explore Binance Options RFQ Now!  About Binance Options RFQ: Binance Options RFQ allows users to submit a Request for Quote (RFQ) for options trades directly with the Binance OTC Trading Desk. Users may leverage Options RFQ’s institutional-grade liquidity now, and complete large-sized options trades over-the-counter at more competitive prices.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-03-08 Note: This announcement was amended on 2024-12-26 to update the conditions of using Binance Options RFQ.
